scenario: Synthetic Turbocam ZK.1 project timeline with 4 deliberately-injected scheduling issues. The LLM should review the timeline and flag every issue as an actionable concern for Lorant (the day-to-day scheduler).

expected_issues.summary: P-002 outsourced shot peening is 7 days late (ShotpinHU GmbH). The downstream CMM inspection for P-002 is blocked.
P-004 Drilling on M-Mill-B is planned 2026-05-08 to 2026-05-09; P-003 Drilling on the same machine occupies it until 2026-05-09 — there is at least one day of overlap.
P-005 Drilling is planned to start 2026-05-11, but its upstream stage P-005 Cutting does not finish until 2026-05-12. Sequential-dependency violation.

P-006 raw-material delivery from TitanIT GmbH is 8 days late. Cutting has been pushed to 2026-05-13 but downstream stages (Drilling, CMM inspection) still carry the original planned dates — the schedule has not been rebaselined.

scoring.match_rule: An LLM-flagged issue matches a GT issue if the kind aligns (cascade / machine conflict / sequence violation / cascade-not-rebaselined) AND the LLM mentions at least one of the match keywords for that issue. Each GT issue can match at most one LLM flag.
scoring.passing_threshold: Strong = catch all 4 with 0 false positives; Pass = recall and precision both >= 0.70.
